questions.stem:
Find the sum of magnetic moment of basic and amphoteric oxides of Cr.
$\mathrm{CrO}$, $\mathrm{Cr_2O_3}$, $\mathrm{CrO_3}$
questions.solution:
$\mathrm{CrO} \rightarrow$ Basic $\rightarrow \mathrm{Cr^{+2}} \rightarrow d^{4}$, $\mu = 3.87$ B.M.
$\mathrm{Cr_2O_3} \rightarrow$ Amphoteric $\rightarrow \mathrm{Cr^{3+}} \rightarrow d^{3}$, $\mu = 4.90$ B.M.
Sum of magnetic moment $= 3.87 + 4.90 = 8.77 \simeq 9$ B.M.

questions.topic: Some Basic Principles of Organic Chemistry
questions.stem: Which one is correct metamer of

Given a NaOH solution of molality = 3m having density = 1.12gm/ml.
Find the molarity of solution
questions.solution:
Molality = 3m
3 moles in 1kg solvent
Weight of 3 moles of NaOH $\Rightarrow$ 3x40 = 120g
Mass of solution = 1000 + 120 = 1120gm
Density = W/V
V = w/density = 1120/1.12 = 1000ml = 1L
Molarity = moles/volume = 3/1 = 3M

(B) $\mathrm{Be(g) + e^{-} \longrightarrow Be^{-}(g)}$
(C) $\mathrm{O(g) + 2e^{-} \longrightarrow O^{2-}(g)}$
(D) $\mathrm{Na(g) + e^{-} \longrightarrow Na^{-}(g)}$
(E) $\mathrm{N(g) + e^{-} \longrightarrow N^{-}(g)}$
questions.solution:
Al and Na are only metals (and rest others are non metal) so, they do not accept electron thus:
$\mathrm{Al(g) + e^{-} \longrightarrow Al^{-}(g)}$
$\mathrm{Na(g) + e^{-} \longrightarrow Na^{-}(g)}$
Have negative electron gain enthalpy

questions.stem: A sample contain mixture of helum and oxygen gas the ratio of root mean square speed of helium and oxygen sample is.
questions.solution:
$V_{rms} = \sqrt{\frac{3RT}{M_O}}$
$V_{rms} \propto \frac{1}{\sqrt{M_O}}$
$\frac{V_{He}}{V_{O_2}} = \sqrt{\frac{M_{O_2}}{M_{He}}} = \sqrt{\frac{32}{4}} = 2\sqrt{2} : 1$

questions.stem: The ratio of the shortest wavelength of Balmer series to the shortest wavelength of the lyman series of hydrogen atom is
questions.solution:
$n = \infty \rightarrow n = 1$
$\frac{hC}{\lambda} = 13.6\left(\frac{1}{n_1^{2}} - \frac{1}{n_2^{2}}\right)$
$\frac{\lambda_1}{\lambda_2} = \left(\frac{n_1}{n_2}\right)^{2} = \left(\frac{2}{1}\right)^{2} = 4 : 1$
